card.name: Adjective after 'as' in comparisons
card.fires_on: The adjective or quantity word right after 'as' (or 'that') in an 'as ... as' comparison, such as old, late, great, close, much. It fires before the second 'as' or a reference point.

modes.label: as + adjective
modes.description: An adjective such as old, late, great or close directly after the first 'as' of an equal comparison.
modes.example: The practice of birth control is as<< old>> as human existence.

modes.label: that much
modes.description: The word 'much' after 'that' or 'half that', which compares an amount to an earlier one.
modes.example: but only half that<< much>> junk mail (22 percent) is
